Twin Blade Combat Styles

Choose Twin Blade for repeated attacks that build momentum or spread bleeding.

Twin Blade - Cyclone

Cyclone includes quick repeated attacks and strikes against several nearby enemies.

Lacerator attacks apply Bleed and can spread it to another nearby enemy.
